record.paper_title: Open problems in deformations of Artinian algebras, Hilbert schemes and around
record.original_question: Let [Γ] be a point of the smoothable component of the Gorenstein locus Hilb^Gor_d(A^4) such that dim T_[Γ] Hilb_d(A^4) - 4d is small. Can one classify the resulting singularities up to smooth equivalence?

evidence.quote: Problem XXVIII (Mildly singular points of HilbGor_d(A^4)). Let [Γ] ∈ HilbGor_d(A^4) be a point of the smoothable component. Suppose that the surplus dim T[Γ] Hilbd(A^4) − 4d is small. Can we classify singularities of such points up to smooth equivalence?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $0$, and let $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^4)$ denote the Hilbert scheme parametrizing zero-dimensional closed subschemes of $\mathbb{A}^4_k$ of length $d$. Let $\mathrm{Hilb}^{\mathrm{Gor}}_d(\mathbb{A}^4) \subseteq \mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^4)$ be the open locus parametrizing those subschemes $\Gamma$ whose structure sheaf $\mathcal{O}_\Gamma$ is a Gorenstein $k$-algebra. Let $\mathrm{Hilb}^{\mathrm{sm}}_d(\mathbb{A}^4)$ denote the smoothable component, defined as the closure of the locus of reduced subschemes consisting of $d$ distinct points; this component has dimension $4d$, and a point $[\Gamma]$ on it is smooth in $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^4)$ if and only if $\dim_k T_{[\Gamma]} \mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^4) = 4d$.

For a point $[\Gamma] \in \mathrm{Hilb}^{\mathrm{Gor}}_d(\mathbb{A}^4) \cap \mathrm{Hilb}^{\mathrm{sm}}_d(\mathbb{A}^4)$, define its surplus by
$$ s([\Gamma]) := \dim_k T_{[\Gamma]} \mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^4) - 4d \ \geq\ 0. $$
Two pointed schemes $(X_1, x_1)$ and $(X_2, x_2)$ are called smoothly equivalent if there exist a scheme $Y$, a point $y \in Y$, and smooth morphisms $Y \to X_1$ and $Y \to X_2$ sending $y$ to $x_1$ and $x_2$ respectively.

Problem: For small values of the surplus $s$, classify, up to smooth equivalence, the singularities of the Hilbert scheme $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^4)$ at points $[\Gamma]$ of the smoothable Gorenstein locus with $s([\Gamma]) = s$.
artifact.status_search_result: No source found that provides a classification of singularities of the smoothable Gorenstein component of $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^4)$ at points of small surplus up to smooth equivalence. Related work (e.g., on elementary components of the Gorenstein locus and on smoothability up to degree 14) does not address this classification, and the problem appears still open.

status_evidence.title: New elementary components of the Gorenstein locus of the Hilbert scheme of points
status_evidence.snippet: An infinite family of elementary and generically smooth components on affine four-space is identified.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work studies components of the Gorenstein locus on A^4 but does not classify mild singularities up to smooth equivalence.

status_evidence.title: Hilbert schemes of points and their applications (PhD thesis, Jelisiejew)
status_evidence.snippet: Every finite Gorenstein scheme of degree at most 14 is smoothable except for (1,6,6,1); all schemes of degree at most 13 are smoothable.
status_evidence.claim: Smoothability results in low degree are known, but the smooth-equivalence classification of mildly singular points is not given.
